result.instructions: Tools for Omnisend, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which automations are enabled right now, and when did each one last change?"; "How many contacts are in our VIP segment?"; "Find the contact jane@example.com and show her tags and subscription status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Omnisend data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run omnisend_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run omnisend_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run omnisend_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. omnisend_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: omnisend_get_brand
tools.title: Get brand
tools.description: Get the connected Omnisend brand: id, name, website, currency, timezone, and platform. Good first call to confirm which store the key belongs to. GET /brands/current.

tools.name: omnisend_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts with cursor paging and optional filters (email, phone, subscription status, segment, tag, or updatedAtFrom). Note: tag and status cannot be combined, and updatedAtFrom cannot be combined with email, phone, status, segmentID, or tag. GET /contacts.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: paging.cursors.after from the previous response.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page: paging.cursors.before from the previous response.

status.description: Subscription status. Cannot be combined with tag.

tag.description: Filter by tag. Cannot be combined with status.

tools.name: omnisend_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: email, phone, name, status, tags, segments, custom properties, and consent. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: omnisend_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List catalog products with offset paging. Optional title search and sort by date, updatedAt, or createdAt. GET /products.

offset.description: Offset of the first item (offset-based paging).

title_contains.description: Only products whose title contains this text.

tools.name: omnisend_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product by id: title, description, status, tags, vendor, category ids, images, and variants with prices. GET /products/{productID}.

tools.name: omnisend_list_product_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List product categories with offset paging. Sort by title, updatedAt, or createdAt. GET /product-categories.

offset.description: Offset of the first item (offset-based paging).

tools.name: omnisend_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns (email, SMS, push) with cursor paging and filters for status, channel, type, name, and date ranges. GET /campaigns.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: paging.cursors.after from the previous response.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page: paging.cursors.before from the previous response.

status.description: Campaign status, for example draft, scheduled, sent.

name_contains.description: Only campaigns whose name contains this text.

channel.description: Channel, for example email, sms, or push.

tools.name: omnisend_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: name, status, channel, type, audience, content reference, sending settings, and start/end times. GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: omnisend_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List contact segments with cursor paging. Sort by createdAt or name. GET /segments.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: paging.cursors.after from the previous response.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page: paging.cursors.before from the previous response.

tools.name: omnisend_get_segment_statistics
tools.title: Get segment statistics
tools.description: Get the number of contacts in a segment (contactsCount). Returns 409 while the segment is still building. GET /segments/{segmentID}/statistics.

tools.name: omnisend_list_automations
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: List automation workflows with cursor paging and filters for enabled state, name, and date ranges. GET /automations.

after.description: Cursor for the next page: paging.cursors.after from the previous response.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page: paging.cursors.before from the previous response.

is_enabled.description: Only enabled (true) or only disabled (false) workflows.

name_contains.description: Only automations whose name contains this text.

tools.name: omnisend_get_automation
tools.title: Get automation
tools.description: Get one automation workflow by id: name, enabled state, trigger, blocks, exit conditions, and settings. GET /automations/{id}.

tools.name: omnisend_create_or_update_contact
tools.title: Create or update contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update it when the email or phone already exists (upsert). Give at least one of email or phone. The welcome message is off unless send_welcome_message is true. POST /contacts.

phone.description: Contact phone in E.164 format, for example +14155550100.

tags.description: Tags to add to the contact.

send_welcome_message.description: Send the welcome message if the welcome workflow is enabled (default false).

tools.name: omnisend_add_contact_tags
tools.title: Add tags to contacts
tools.description: Add one or more tags to contacts chosen by contact ids, emails, phone numbers, or a segment (up to 250 per list). Re-adding a tag does nothing new. POST /contacts/tags.

phones.description: Contact phone numbers in E.164 format.

segment_id.description: Add the tags to every contact in this segment.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Omnisend
prompts.description: What you can do with Omnisend here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_which_automations_are_enabled
prompts.title: Check which automations are enabled
prompts.description: List the automation workflows, filtered by enabled state. Open one to read its trigger and blocks.

prompts.name: size_a_segment_before_a_campaign
prompts.title: Size a segment before a campaign
prompts.description: List the contact segments, then read the contact count of one. The count is not ready while a segment is still building.

prompts.name: look_up_a_contact_by_email
prompts.title: Look up a contact by email
prompts.description: List contacts filtered by email, then open one to read its tags, status, segments and consent.

prompts.name: tag_the_contacts_of_a_segment
prompts.title: Tag the contacts of a segment
prompts.description: Find the segment id, then add a tag to every contact in it. Re-adding a tag changes nothing new.

prompts.name: create_or_update_a_contact_from_a_signup
prompts.title: Create or update a contact from a signup
prompts.description: Create a contact, or update it when the email or phone exists. The welcome message stays off unless you set its flag.

prompts.name: review_the_product_catalog
prompts.title: Review the product catalog
prompts.description: List the catalog products and product categories. Open one product to read its variants and prices.
